value: If a normal support witness has active support A strictly smaller than support S and A contains all required payload/certificate/lift/status fields, projecting to A and renormalizing gives a smaller witness candidate under the selected support measure, while status is preserved under locality, reduced if the projected status is valid, or routed to named blocker/deferred escape.

Support_size strictly decreases under strict active-subset precondition; project-to-active locality is proof-ready with payload locality proved and status-domain/normal-form/reduced-status obligations open.
active_support is the union of payload, certificate/status, frontier/shell/tail, canonical motif, and family-chain lift dependency coordinates
normal support witness W with finite support set S and support_size greater than 8
support_size k to |A|<k; lexicographic measure strictly decreases
A=S -> no-op and next operation; invalid projection/status locality failure -> named blocker; all operations fail -> deferred higher-support escape
delete_redundant deletes one redundant coordinate; project_to_active restricts to the whole active subset and may remove multiple inactive coordinates

status-domain invariance;complete status dependency extraction;normal-form preservation under active projection;family-chain source-form preservation;valid reduced-status fallback;remaining operation congruence/alignment/measure sublemmas
Does not prove every support>8 witness has inactive support, does not prove project-to-active fully, and does not prove all support-reduction operations.
